Wavelengths 1480/1500/1490 (TX) apply to all; bit rates 2.488 Gbps Tx and 1.244 Gbps Rx—using 2.488 as the host line rate per operating conditions. C++ has TX power and overload only (no C++ sensitivity row).

RX wavelength atoms (1290 / 1330 / 1310 nm) are not assigned per mode because the schema has a single wavelength triple and the grouped rows are keyed by GPON class and BER, not by RX-only rows. `G.984.2` is module-wide compliance, not a separate selectable mode. No penalties were in the input pool.
